title: Da Goobers
description: Claws of berk with some multiplayer quality of life (QOL) mods. Put together by me and some friends for fun online gameplay
body: Fun server for friends. While were very new to modding gameplay, were very happy to know that many people have created many mods that help QOL improvement, as well as big mods such as Claws of Berk to fuel our nerdy tendencies.
